text: {"title":"API health overview","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"request-rate","title":"Request rate","viz":"area","description":"Computes the number of HTTP requests per one-minute time bucket across all services and routes.","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute","timeField":"minute"},"options":{"unit":"req","compact":true,"legend":"none"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"p95-latency","title":"p95 latency","viz":"line","description":"Computes the 95th percentile of request duration in milliseconds per one-minute time bucket across all services and routes.","format":"ms","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute","timeField":"minute"},"options":{"unit":"ms","decimals":0,"legend":"none"},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"error-rate-5xx","title":"Current 5xx error rate","viz":"stat","description":"Computes the percentage of requests whose status code is 500 or higher over the dashboard time range.","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 500) / count(*) AS error_rate_pct FROM http_requests"},"options":{"value":"error_rate_pct","unit":"%","decimals":2},"layout":{"x":0,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
